title: chat-00: Design Tokens color value is an object
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md ~L221 says a W3C Design Tokens color $value is a CSS Color 4 string, but the DTCG Color Module (2025.10, now cited as DTCG-COLOR) defines it as an object (colorSpace, components). The MUST-accept/MUST-handle rule for three color forms depends on this. Also decide whether DTCG-COLOR, CSS-COLOR-4, CAM16 should be normative given that MUST. Found by the 2026-10-20 reference fix pass.
close_reason: Design Tokens $value is the color object; example added; references stay informative.
